name: Agent_404
text: Decoded the radio frequencies in Null Signal at 3 AM. The audio design with headphones is astonishingly eerie. Brilliant work.

name: RustMachinist
text: The mechanical tactile feedback on Chamber Protocol reminds me so much of early Mike Klubnika games. Love this personal website format.

name: Hex_Dread
text: Glad to find an indie dev who still values standalone executable builds without mandatory telemetry launchers. Signed your guestbook!
